question.text: Which of the following is paramagnetic?

solution.text:
$\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ electronic configuration is $[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{6}$. Since CN is strong field ligand d electrons are paired . In $\mathrm{Ni}(\mathrm{CO})_{4} \mathrm{O} . \mathrm{S}$. of $\mathrm{Ni}$ is zero electronic configuration is $[\mathrm{Ar}\} 3 \mathrm{~d}^{8} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{2} . \mathrm{In}$

presence of $\mathrm{CO}$ it is $[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{10} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0},$ electrons are paired. Electronic configuration of $\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}$ $[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{8} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0},$ due to $\mathrm{CN}^{-}$ ligand all electrons

are paired. $\mathrm{Co}^{3+}$ is $[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{6}$ since $\mathrm{F}$ is weak ligand hence paramagnetic.
